name: Chicago Loop Map Layers
description: Downtown Chicago, longitude -87.662 to -87.605, latitude 41.859 to 41.906: the Loop with the West Loop, the South Loop, Streeterville and the lakefront up to Oak Street Beach, as eight layers of every geometry an Autark map draws: tracts.geojson (48); buildings.parquet (10,075); parks.geojson (965); water.geojson (78); roads.parquet (8,448); cta_lines.geojson (38); trees.geojson (13,742); cta_stations.geojson (30). Tracts: CDC/ATSDR's Social Vulnerability Index 2020 for the Cook County tracts that meet the box, cut at it (CDC's column names, -999 missing; AREA_SQMI is the whole tract's). Buildings: Overture Maps release 2026-09-23.1, height in metres where Overture has it. Parks, water, roads and trees (natural=tree): OpenStreetMap, from BBBike's Chicago extract. CTA 'L' lines and stations: City of Chicago data portal. All EPSG:4326. Built by scripts/build_chicago_loop_layers_dataset.py.
